object_description: raised and extended main building with a covered reception courtyard
design_condition: The intervention extends the existing main volume on the downstream side and raises it by two levels, reinforcing the entrance courtyard while preserving the dominant building, landscape setting and heritage presence.

positive.statement: The approach respects and strengthens the existing identity and the spatial, architectural and natural qualities of the site.

position.rationale: Broad site judgment anchored to the extended building, courtyard, and surrounding sampled landscape edges.

positive.statement: The compact intervention as an extension and raising of the main volume finds full meaning in the landscape context.

position.rationale: The dominant eastern volume visibly extends and rises above the lower western mass.

positive.statement: The covered reception space establishes a strong relationship between the main building and the gym.

position.rationale: Central covered courtyard zone is positioned between the raised main volume and lower gym-like wing.

positive.statement: The enlarged theater, new square and exterior extensions provide high-quality gathering and terrace spaces.

position.rationale: Open gathering areas are approximated along the lower western extension and courtyard edge.

positive.statement: The distribution of functions is relevant, with the dining space correctly connected to the landscape, gym and aula.

position.rationale: Interior program is anchored near the lower central connection between landscape-facing and gym-like volumes.

positive.statement: The exceptional top floor combines a strong relationship with the sky and city with study rooms, a library and generous outdoor space.

position.rationale: Distinct upper level and roof footprint are clearly visible on the raised eastern block.

positive.statement: The proposals promote the heritage witness and create a convincing dialogue with vegetation and nature.

position.rationale: Landscape relationship is distributed along the sampled perimeter surrounding the intervention.

positive.statement: The gym is very little affected by the intervention.

position.rationale: Gym is approximated within the lower western wing, largely separate from the raised volume.

negative.statement: Raising the building by two levels will probably require strengthening the foundations.

position.rationale: Foundation concern is anchored directly beneath the visibly raised eastern building mass.

negative.statement: The formalization of the new staircase, particularly its relationship to the elevators and light void, is unconvincing.

position.rationale: Circulation core is approximated within the central portion of the raised volume.

negative.statement: The two open stairwells do not function as escape routes.

position.rationale: Stairwell locations are constrained to the tall central circulation region of the raised block.

negative.statement: Independent use of the dining space in connection with the gym outside school hours is difficult.

position.rationale: Dining operations are anchored near the lower connection between the gym and exterior-facing spaces.
